title: polygonum atlanticum
intro: Polygonum atlanticum, commonly known as Sea Buckthorn, is a type of shrub native to the coastal regions of the Atlantic coast in Europe. This plant has been utilized for its medicinal properties, particularly for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, helping to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Sea Buckthorn include promoting wound healing, reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
